description: Comptages Routiers ponctuels is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Toulouse Métropole. Les données de comptage routier sont effectuées sur la métropole via des tubes pneumatiques installés sur la chaussée sur une période d'une semaine (installation non permanente) depuis 2014. Chaque période de comptage correspond à une semaine complète. La donnée affichée est le TMJO (Taux Moyen Jours Ouvrés) tous les véhicules sont comptés. Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are déplacement, mobilité, comptages routier, commute. The portal shows 3,735 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2019-04-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
